sentences.text: The contribution agreement for this $8.4M Indigenous Services Canada recipient carries a null description in the Open Data extract.
The Indigenous Services Canada Departmental Results Report identifies the program area's expected outcomes around community-driven wellness and culturally-grounded service delivery.
Briefs in this program corpus typically reference community-led program design, partnership with regional health authorities, and reporting to the recipient nation's leadership.
Comparable filings often describe deliverables in terms of service-access targets and community engagement activities.
